titleEn: Global pork production braces for a slower 2027
titleZh: 全球猪肉产量预计2027年放缓增长
summaryZh: 荷兰合作银行最新《全球猪肉季度报告》指出，2026年第四季度生猪市场疲软、回报不佳，导致2027年全球猪肉产量扩张计划减少。生产商因国内和出口需求疲软、饲料和燃料成本上升而缺乏留种扩栏动力，将转而聚焦猪群健康、生产力和自动化。北美、欧洲和中国等主要市场利润承压，可能加速行业整合，迫使高成本生产商淘汰或退出。
featuredReason: 该报告揭示了全球猪肉行业2027年的关键转向——从扩群增产转向健康、生产力和自动化投资，直接点明了智慧畜牧技术（如猪群健康监测、自动化设备）在行业利润承压期的落地机遇，对关注猪业智能化升级的从业者具有战略参考价值。
contentFull:
UTRECHT, NETHERLANDS — Softer pork demand has global markets reexamining production for 2027, according to the latest Global Pork Quarterly report from Rabobank. Poor returns and weak hog markets through the fourth quarter of 2026 means fewer production expansion plans for the coming year. Producers lack incentives to retain gilts and increase capacity when domestic and export demand is weak, amid higher feed and fuel costs.

Consequently, Rabobank expects producers will focus on herd health, productivity and automation, rather than herd expansion in the upcoming year.

Herd health continues to be a challenge across several regions, but investments to modernize swine production and stabilize health issues in 2026 is expected to drive further productivity gains in 2027.

Rabobank noted margin pressure could accelerate industry consolidation, forcing high-cost producers to cull or exit altogether.

Margin compression occurred in key markets like North America, Europe and China. Prices vary by region but remain below year-ago levels in most markets as consumer demand falls short of expectations, the report said.

In North America, inflationary pressures and lower purchasing power weighed on belly demand across foodservice channels. Retail channels also fell below expectations as demand for processed meat items slowed as consumers faced inflationary pressure and adopted new diet trends.

In Europe, pork prices remain low as export disruption continues to compound already large domestic supplies. EU pork supplies are expected to moderate in 2027.

As for China, pork markets appear to have stabilized. However, they face softer demand as consumers increase beef and chicken consumption.
translationZh:
荷兰乌得勒支——根据荷兰合作银行最新的《全球猪肉季度报告》，猪肉需求走软正促使全球市场重新审视2027年的产量。2026年第四季度回报不佳和生猪市场疲软，意味着来年产量扩张计划减少。在国内和出口需求疲软、饲料和燃料成本上升的情况下，生产商缺乏保留后备母猪和扩大产能的动力。

因此，荷兰合作银行预计，生产商在来年将聚焦猪群健康、生产力和自动化，而非扩群。

多个地区的猪群健康仍是一大挑战，但2026年为现代化生猪生产 and 稳定健康问题所做的投资，预计将在2027年推动生产力进一步提升。

荷兰合作银行指出，利润压力可能加速行业整合，迫使高成本生产商淘汰或彻底退出。

北美、欧洲和中国等主要市场均出现利润压缩。报告称，各地价格不一，但由于消费需求不及预期，多数市场价格仍低于去年同期水平。

在北美，通胀压力和购买力下降拖累了餐饮服务渠道的猪腹肉需求。零售渠道也低于预期，因消费者面临通胀压力并采用新的饮食趋势，加工肉制品需求放缓。

在欧洲，由于出口中断继续加剧本已庞大的国内供应，猪肉价格仍处低位。预计2027年欧盟猪肉供应将有所缓和。

至于中国，猪肉市场似乎已趋于稳定。然而，随着消费者增加牛肉和鸡肉消费，猪肉需求面临走软。
contentHtml: Weak demand, compressed margins and rising production costs are prompting producers to prioritize herd health, productivity and automation over expansion.
